reason: The passage depicts Moses taking unilateral, violent action (killing the Egyptian) without authorization, being challenged by the Hebrew man with the question 'Who made you a ruler and judge over us?', and responding with fear (וַיִּירָ֤א מֹשֶׁה) rather than humble engagement with the criticism. Moses then flees to Midian. The text does not present this sequence as a model of good leadership through humility in the face of criticism. Rather, it illustrates the consequences of acting without proper authority and failing to establish legitimate standing among one's people.
